items.rationale: This is a canonical password-manager vulnerability class.
items.finding: Unsafe autofill: content script fills credentials into any password field without verifying origin matches stored credential URL
items.evidence: content.ts: 'const passwordField = document.querySelector("input[type=\"password\"]")' - no URL/origin check against stored credential domain before filling. Popup sends credentials to any active tab.
items.action: Verify tab URL origin matches credential's stored domain; require user confirmation per autofill; avoid auto-filling without user-initiated gesture on matching domain.

items.rationale: Stored auth_hash is essentially equivalent to leaking master-key-derived material; combined with unsafe autofill this fails credential security.
items.finding: Auth hash derived with 1 PBKDF2 iteration and constant salt allows offline attack on master key if DB leaks; also unsafe autofill present
items.evidence: deriveBits with 'iterations: 1' and 'salt: encoder.encode("auth-salt-constant")' for authHash. Server stores this hash directly without server-side hashing.
items.action: Server should additionally hash the received auth hash with bcrypt/argon2 before storage; use per-user salt for auth derivation; document limitations.
